posts.body:
Is there a place that people have been using for creating commission requests for plugins?
I was thinking of the typical contract work like Freelancer, Upwork, or even Fiverr. I also saw a few pages on Reddit for commission requests, but it seems like very informal development.
I was also curious if people would be interested in fundraising public plugins or tools for all RPG Maker users?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Freedom said:
Is there a place that people have been using for creating commission requests for plugins?
Click to expand...
There's a commission section right on these forums where many users have threads advertising their services (and a corresponding request section). You have enough posts to be able to see them.
Freedom said:
I was also curious if people would be interested in fundraising public plugins or tools for all RPG Maker users?
Click to expand...
I think that's too broad/vague a question to get a definitive answer. Plugins do particular things and are thus project-specific; there are very few that you could say "everyone can benefit from this." So the willingness of other people to contribute to this would depend on the plugin being something that they'd personally find useful.
Other issues would include:
- it feeling somewhat unfair that the contributors would be paying the plugin author to produce something that everyone else would get for free.
- the willingness of the author to take the commission work and then not get any further revenue from it. Logically, anything you think many users would benefit from would be something they could likely get sales of.
Some authors are willing to offer reduced prices for their commissions if they can retain the rights to
sell
the plugin after (as opposed to it being specific to your project), but I haven't heard of anyone doing this.
